text: おぬしの　＊に　＊　という　わざ　おしえさせて　みては　もらえぬか？

structure.jp: おしえさせて　みては
structure.en: trying to let me teach it
could I not have you do that?

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb says someone lets or makes another person do it. おしえさせて = 'let (me) teach'.

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: おしえさせて　みては　もらえぬか
patterns.explanation: もらう after a て-form says you get someone to do something for you. もらえぬか is old-fashioned for もらえないか, a polite 'couldn't I have you...?'. おしえさせて　みては　もらえぬか = 'would you let me try teaching it?'

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: おしえさせて　みて
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form says you try doing something to see how it goes. おしえさせて　みて = 'try letting me teach'.
